description: This file defines options and validator classes for ADO.NET grain storage in Orleans, including configuration properties, validation logic, and default setup for storage options.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptions
classes.description: Represents configuration options for ADO.NET grain storage, including connection string, invariants, init stage, and hash picker.

classes.name: AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator
classes.description: Validates the correctness of AdoNetGrainStorageOptions, ensuring required fields are set.

classes.name: DefaultAdoNetGrainStorageOptionsHashPickerConfigurator
classes.description: Provides default hash picker configuration for AdoNetGrainStorageOptions if none is set.

methods.name: UseOrleans3CompatibleHasher
methods.description: Sets a legacy hash picker compatible with Orleans v3 for the storage options.

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Performs validation on the storage options, checking for required fields.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: Sets a default hash picker if none was configured.
